pairs.english: Mira tapped his newly recorded reading, telling him not to lose the record folder.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉伸手点点他刚记的数，叫他别把记录夹丢。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ liǎngzhāng zhǐ fēnkāi shōu hǎo , gēnzhe tā wǎng fàntáng zǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi put the two sheets away separately and followed her toward the dining hall.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把两张纸分开收好，跟着她往饭堂走。

pairs.target: dào ménkǒu cái xiǎngqǐ , zìjǐ dāying zhàn zuò de rén , yǐjīng zǒu zài zìjǐ qiánmiàn le .
pairs.english: Only at the door did he remember that the person he'd promised to save seats for was already walking ahead of him.
pairs.hanzi: 到门口才想起，自己答应占座的人，已经走在自己前面了。
